title: Personalized Basketball with Paint Splash Comforter with Name and Number
description:
Transform any bedroom into a sports haven with this custom basketball bedding set by Jeminise. Perfect for basketball players and sports enthusiasts, this comforter or duvet cover is designed to showcase your passion for the game while offering personalized details to make it truly yours. Create a cozy and stylish bedroom space with a design that features a realistic basketball on a net background, complete with your custom jersey name and number.

Key Features

  • Personalized Customization: Easily add your custom name (up to 30 characters) and jersey number (up to 5 characters) for a unique sports-themed design.
  • Product Versatility: Available in both Duvet Cover and filled Comforter options to perfectly match your bedding preferences.
  • Premium Material: Crafted from 100% Brushed Polyester Fabric that is soft, durable, cozy, and lightweight.
  • High-Quality Fill: Comforter option features whole-piece microfiber filling with tight, smooth stitching that prevents clumping, shifting, or fading over time.
  • Available Sizes: Offered in standard US sizes including Twin (68" x 88"), Full (78" x 88"), Queen (88" x 88"), and King (104" x 88").
  • Optional Components: Customize your bed set further by choosing to add 1 or 2 matching pillowcases and an additional flat sheet cover.
  • Easy Care Instructions: Machine washable in cold water on a gentle cycle; air dry or tumble dry with no heat to quickly restore fluffiness.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Comforter
Material Polyester
Fabric Type Cotton/ Polyester
Fill Material Microfiber
Selected Design Basketball D5
Pattern Basketball Print
Style Sports Decor
Seasons All Seasons
Customization Custom Name & Number (2 text inputs)
Care Instructions Machine Wash
